notes: #4 (1726) and #3 (1702) are later, smaller states of the de Fer plate. #10 (Barberi’s general view from the hills, same series, BM dates 1824–35) is a P3 alternative, but trees fill most of the frame. #14 date is the Rijksmuseum’s; #19 is the Library of Congress copy of a similar market view (dated only 1890s). P5 alternative: #23 (1929, the Promenade des Anglais and Jetée-Promenade from above). #22 was taken for a press report on a party congress, but the view itself is ordinary.
